ordinary_change_requirements: observed changed paths exactly bound to a RepoChangeEnvelope
repo profile resolves each changed artifact
required Garden modules are not silently omitted
material code/workflow/config changes carry source obligation references
authority_ref resolves from protected base authority registry
constitutional_rule: A change touching constitutional_paths cannot be authorized by request-supplied booleans or by the changed registry/policy itself. It requires an externally verifiable human approval or a trusted base-bound approval receipt. Until that verifier exists, such a change must remain candidate/ESCALATE.
canonical_rule: Published Garden v15.5 source files are immutable in place. Canonical successor promotion is outside repository-agent authority and remains human-controlled.
documentation_rule: Purely explanatory documentation may be source-obligation-exempt only when it does not alter normative semantics, authority, policy, executable behavior or release claims; the envelope must explicitly classify that exemption.
